svg.aria-label: Animated customer intelligence and business impact dashboard
svg.title: Customer Intelligence and Business Impact
svg.desc: Animated dashboard summarizing 2026 distributor customer identification results, operational efficiency, CRM visibility, sales opportunities, and annualized labor cost equivalent.
svg.text: Distributor-to-CRM Reconciliation • Python Automation • Business Intelligence • Sales Enablement
June 2026 • Distributor purchasing records reconciled with Dynamics 365 CRM
Using identification-confidence scores to improve research efficiency
Blue = share of customer records • Green = customer identification rate
FROM BETTER CUSTOMER IDENTIFICATION TO SALES OPPORTUNITIES
Connecting previously unidentified distributor purchases to actionable customer records
Improved capacity for reporting and analysis
Equivalent to two $57,000 annual base salaries

Sample: 877 records. Customer identification improved from approximately 60% to 80–90%. Revenue opportunities are potential, not verified sales. $114,000 is a salary equivalent, not verified net savings.
